entries.source_scope: Exact manufacturer model facts and separately attributed dated external offers; no live store commerce, physical stock or native product bindings.

facts.value: LDO manufacturer source: Adds two integrated TMC5160 stepper drivers.

proofs.quote: 2x Integrated TMC5160 stepper drivers.

facts.value: LDO manufacturer source: Adds two protected fan ports with selectable 12/24 V and tachometer inputs, plus two thermistor ports with 2.2 kΩ pullups.

proofs.quote:
2x Fan ports with flyback protection, 12V/24V selectable voltage, and tachometer inputs. 
- 2x Thermistor ports with 2k2 ohm pullup resistors.

facts.value: On 13 October 2026, the captured Australian source displayed AUD 85.00 for LDO Leviathan expansion board. This is a dated external reference, not a live 3D Byte offer. GST, shipping, landed cost, availability and exact received package are unverified unless separately stated in the citation.
